::: {.callout-note appearance='simple' collapse=true}
## Source

Adapted from Kameron Decker Harris's Fall 2026 lecture notes "Proofs Involving Sets",
which are typed transcriptions of Scott Wehrwein's Spring 2025 handwritten lecture notes.
These come from those notes:

- what to show to prove that an element is in a set given in set-builder notation;
- the direct and contrapositive outlines of a subset proof;
- proving set equality by proving that each set is a subset of the other;
- the theorem that a nonempty factor cancels from both sides of an equation between Cartesian products,
  with the proof of its first half.

The exercises, the second half of that proof, the membership test for a set built with an expression,
and the section on disproving a claim about sets are new.
:::
